verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at twilio.com/llms.txt that links to markdown pages (e.g. en-us.md). A Markdown rendering of the docs is also served at docs.md, and llms.txt carries substantive product content. Twilio additionally documents an MCP server that gives AI coding agents structured access to its public API specs with no authentication, a further agent-oriented docs channel. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents actually use these llms.txt and Markdown docs effectively.
